leadText:
Deoxys's unnamed world is an -exclusive location found in another dimension. It was featured in Pokémon Ranger - Deoxys' Crisis! Part 1 and Part 2.

 had to hide in the Pokémon world because of the force created by a meteor. The geomagnetic forces were too powerful for it to handle and caused it intense pain. Deoxys took Max to another dimension to try to communicate with him about what was causing it pain. In order to do that though, Deoxys also kidnapped to speak with Max.

To get Max back, , , and Solana fought Deoxys to get it back to its for Solana to capture it. After the meteor was destroyed, Solana used a 's to heal Deoxys. After it was healed, Deoxys flew off.
